title: Network authorization clearing message received
description: A Clearing/Base II event. This event has the same purpose as an iso8583 event, as it represents a raw message received from the card network. The Pismo platform issues a Clearing/Base II event after parsing the message and removing any sensitive data from the payload. You can use a Clearing/Base II event to verify all non-sensitive data received for Clearing/Base II messages. For more information, see the Authorization events guide.

file_type.title: File type
file_type.description: Type of file that generated the event.

network.title: Network Identifier
network.description: Network that originated this clearing raw message.

raw_message.description: Contains the ISO8583 message in JSON format. This is different for every network.

account_id.title: Account ID
account_id.description: ID of account impacted by this clearing raw message. This information is fetched using the Card used in the conciliation. If no card is found, this value is null.

card_id.title: Card ID
card_id.description: ID of card received on this clearing raw message. If no card is found based on the PAN received, this value is null.

program_id.title: Program ID
program_id.description: ID of the card's program used on this clearing raw message. If no card is found, this value is null.
